title: Grain Desk Standing Rule: The Bushels a Roll Instruction Moves
content:
The bushels a roll moves on a contract under Grain Marketing Contracts are read against what the contract still owes and against the smallest parcel the member's marketing programme will roll.

**1.** Where the signed roll instruction names more bushels than the contract still owes, the roll moves the bushels the contract still owes, since no more than that remains to be moved.

**2.** Where the instruction names fewer bushels than the roll minimum the member's marketing programme sets, the roll moves that roll minimum.

**3.** Where neither of those holds, the roll moves the bushels the instruction names.

## The roll minimum each programme sets

| Programme | Smallest parcel a single instruction may roll (bushels) |
|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | 0 |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | 1000 |
| Basis Fixed Contract | 5000 |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | 5000 |
| Delayed Price Agreement | 0 |
| Minimum Price Contract | 5000 |
| Managed Accumulator Program | 10000 |

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

A Hedge-to-Arrive Contract still owing 12,000 bushels carries an instruction naming 20,000 bushels: the roll moves 12,000. The same contract with an instruction naming 3,000 bushels moves 5000, that programme's roll minimum. An instruction naming exactly 5000 bushels is neither above the bushels owed nor below the minimum, so the roll moves the 5000 bushels named.
